events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Matthew Knies scored a pair of goals and the Toronto Maple Leafs snapped a three-game losing streak with a 4-2 victory over the Boston Bruins on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knies scores 2 goals and Maple Leafs snap 3-game skid with 4-2 win at Bruins

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored his 44th goal of the season and Jakub Dobes made 41 saves as the Montreal Canadiens held off the Carolina Hurricanes for a 5-2 win on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores his 44th and Dobes makes 41 saves to lead Canadiens past Hurricanes 5-2

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Carter Yakemchuk scored a second-period goal and also had an assist in his NHL debut as the streaking Ottawa Senators edged the Detroit Red Wings 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter Yakemchuk scores in NHL debut as streaking Senators top Red Wings, 3-2

headlines.description: — The Florida Panthers gave up a three-goal, third-period lead but recovered for a 5-4 shootout win over the Seattle Kraken on Tuesday night on Vinnie Hinostroza's goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers rally past the Kraken 5-4 in a shootout after blowing a 3-goal lead

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Anton Frondell had an assist in his NHL debut, Nick Lardis and Frank Nazar each had a goal and an assist and the Chicago Blackhawks...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lardis, Nazar lead Blackhawks past Islanders 4-3, Frondell gets assist in NHL debut

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Zach Werenski continued his torrid scoring pace with a goal and an assist as the Columbus Blue Jackets defeated the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Werenski’s goal and assist power Blue Jackets past Flyers 3-2

headlines.description: — Martin Necas scored twice, Nathan MacKinnon poured in his NHL-leading 46th goal and the Colorado Avalanche breezed past the
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores NHL-leading 46th goal as Avalanche cruise past wobbling Penguins 6-2

events.name: Minnesota Wild at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: - Erik Cernak scored a tiebreaking goal with 2:53 left in the third period when Minnesota goaltender Filip Gustavsson misplayed a carom off the end boards and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cernak scores on crazy carom late in 3rd period as the Lightning beat the Wild 6-3

events.name: Washington Capitals at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud and Otto Stenberg scored, Joel Hofer made 21 saves and the St. Louis Blues beat the Washington Capitals 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hofer makes 21 saves to help Blues beat Washington 3-0

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Filip Forsberg scored a goal and assisted on two others to lead the Nashville Predators to a 6-3 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night in a matchup of teams headed in opposite directions in the standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg has a goal and 2 assists to lead surging Predators over slumping Sharks 6-3

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes scored twice in New Jersey's four-goal first period, and the Devils handed Dallas consecutive losses in regulation for the first time in two months, beating the Stars 6-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes scores twice in a 4-goal 1st for Devils as Stars lose 2nd straight in regulation

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele had a goal and two assists — and a rare fighting major in the second period — to lead the Winnipeg Jets to a 4-1 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele sparks Jets with a goal, 2 assists and a rare fight in a 4-1 win over Golden Knights

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Yegor Sharangovich scored in the fourth round of the shootout to lead the Calgary Flames to a 3-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yegor Sharangovich scores in shootout to lift Flames over Kings 3-2, extending win streak to 4 games

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid scored twice to give him 401 career goals and 1,200 points, sparking the Edmonton Oilers to a 5-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid scores twice to give him 401 career goals and 1,200 points as Oilers top Mammoth 5-2

headlines.description: — Mikael Granlund scored twice, Alex Killorn had a goal and an assist, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Ducks beat the Canucks 5-3 as Mikael Granlund scores 2 goals
